Visual Embed SDK / Embed / Embed a Liveboard

Embed a Liveboard

SDK 1.36.2 · ThoughtSpot 10.8.0.cl

The LiveboardEmbed component renders a Liveboard inside your application. It carries the viewer's permissions and row-level security, so what a person sees in your app is what they would see in ThoughtSpot.

Before you start

  1. Your application's origin must be on the CORS allowlist in Security settings.
  2. Pick an authentication type. Cookieless trusted authentication is the usual choice for customer-facing apps.
  3. Have the Liveboard's GUID to hand — it is the last segment of its URL.

Install

npm install @thoughtspot/visual-embed-sdk

Initialize and render

Reactvisual-embed-sdk@1.36.2
import { init, AuthType } from '@thoughtspot/visual-embed-sdk';
import { LiveboardEmbed } from '@thoughtspot/visual-embed-sdk/react';

init({
  thoughtSpotHost: 'https://champagne-master.thoughtspot.cloud',
  authType: AuthType.TrustedAuthTokenCookieless,
  getAuthToken: getAuthToken
});

export default function Analytics() {
  return (
    <LiveboardEmbed
      liveboardId={"7a1f0c3e-9b24-4d51-8e6a-2c4f7b91d0e5"}
      frameParams={{ width: '100%', height: '720px' }}
    />
  );
}

A blank frame usually means one of two things. Either the origin is not allowlisted, or getAuthToken is returning a cached token instead of a fresh one for the signed-in user. Both show up in the browser console.

Parameters

liveboardId — the GUID of the Liveboard. activeTabId — opens on one tab instead of the first. visibleActions — the menu actions a viewer keeps. customizations — your styles, as CSS variables or a stylesheet URL.

Every parameter on this page is version-bound. Check the version chip above against your own cluster before you copy anything.

Your builds

Everything you have embedded, newest first. Open the Builder to change code and settings, or the live site to see it as a customer.

3 Key Insights for Managers
  1. Concentration Risk ⚠️: Three SDRs (Johanna, James, George) hold 60%+ of high-value pipeline (~8.8M ACV) — if their deals stall at M1, EMEA pipeline takes a major hit.
  2. Expansion Gap 📈: Only ~25% of M1s are expansion opportunities, missing the easiest path to growth.
  3. Stage Drift ⏳: 18 deals have sat in Negotiation for more than 45 days.
